docs.text: It's been windy and cool with occasional rain showers here on the south shore of Lake Superior. #scape

37 degrees outside is a fun temperature to find out your jeans are ripped the entire length of your balls(pennis balls) from lower taint to end of gooch n shaft so if Lake Superior could not be windy today it would be nice because I don’t think my achy breaky balls can take it

lake breeze fans (me) the breeze be breezing, slowly moving west. doing nothing to bring the dewpoint down though so the end result is cooler but more humid - a very low and thin fog is just offshore. also spawned a little biddy thunderstorm (technical term) #ilwx

It has been incredibly cloudy lately in Pennsylvania. Warm temps = warm Great Lakes & blanket the NE-US in what I call... no bones astronomy. Sunday night I might have a great chance at seeing jupiter and streaming it. That will be on TikTok or Instagram depending on the rig l use. Clear Skies!✨🔭🤘
I’ve been looking forward to this all week and as soon as I walked down here the wind shifted and a cold breeze started coming off Lake Superior and it absolutely slaps on a 90° day

This is the time of the calendar year that the lake breeze off Lake Superior really starts to kick in. I have gotten use to the early spring feel in the air that lasts through all of spring. It will feel much better when the natural air conditioning is welcomed during summer!
look, I grew up with this but when I lived in BC and got off the plane into the Great Lakes area (any) in spring/summer the shock was immense. Soup air.
I’m a Lake Superior loving Yooper. Yesterday was nuts weather-wise.

It was 63° here yesterday and it’s 23° with a feels like of 14°. The winds are so strong they’re going to blow out of the western basin of Lake Erie and expose the lake bed. My head is currently killing me with this weather 🤦‍♀️
Nothing like that cool cross breeze on a great lakes region late summer day
The wind coming off Lake Superior is brutally cold!

Lake Superior sends its regards…

We have been having 90 degree weather and I've been chilling by Lake Superior just to have the wind keep me cool

The wind blows constantly here since I live on Lake Erie. I woke up yesterday morning to find that the temp in my room had dropped to 57°F. I didn't even know until I looked because the weighted sherpa blanket and flannel sheets I use are so warm.
Were you getting slight mist / spray off the lake? I was on Lake Erie this morning and it was like an air conditioner, it was great.

We tied the record high temperature of 79 degrees today at 2:11pm! A lake breeze did develop near Lake Erie (including parts of Metro Toledo), the that south wind is now pushing the cooler air to the north. Did you enjoy this preview of summer?
Flying into O'Hare. Great example of air/sea exchange. Open "warm" water giving off vapor that condenses in cold wind from land.
Cloudy AF here in the Great Lakes region, so good luck.

south shore of Lake Superior at 4 am:
clear skies, -6° F with a "feels like" -23°...
my mantra is "at least we don't have to shovel cold"
